arguments.summary: Investigated the issues reported by P17 and found that the 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout, the certificate alert was due to an expired intermediate certificate, and the cron drift was because cron runs jobs in the order they are scheduled. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and the failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table to identify the root cause of the job failures and implement a solution to prevent future failures. Ensure that the certificate is renewed on time and that the cron jobs are scheduled correctly.
